scope: Top 15 ARTCOVR prospects selected from the original 45-account list.
method: Each account has a current public release or campaign signal and one named likely decision-maker backed by a public source. Email addresses were not guessed or added.

targets.current_signal: Current artist and composer roster plus a live 2026 news feed confirm an active multi-client management pipeline.
targets.opening_angle: Your roster spans artists, composers, producers, and songwriters; ARTCOVR can give the marketing team a repeatable visual system for each release without flattening each artist's identity.

targets.current_signal: Anjunadeep Explorations Label Sampler 03 is the imprint's 100th release and was released on 2026-08-21; the catalog also shows a July 2026 sampler.
targets.opening_angle: Lead with the 100th Explorations release: offer a flexible cover-and-social asset system that can keep a 16-track sampler visually coherent while leaving room for each artist's world.

targets.current_signal: Blackstar's current site describes live 360 campaign management and creative direction, and its campaign-management page was updated in July 2026.
targets.opening_angle: Position ARTCOVR as an on-demand visual partner inside Blackstar's 360 campaigns: fast cover variants, cutdowns, and release-ready assets that extend the agency's strategy without adding another full production layer.

targets.current_signal: Ghostly's official store lists Ayurveda's Yours Sincerely for release on 2026-09-11, alongside a continuing artist and visual-artist roster.
targets.opening_angle: Open on Yours Sincerely and Ghostly's music-and-art identity: propose a visual system that can carry a textured release, limited formats, and store assets while staying unmistakably Ghostly.

targets.current_signal: Hyperdub's store currently lists the 2026 vinyl reissue of Burial's Kindred EP and maintains an active releases catalog and roster.
targets.opening_angle: Use the Kindred reissue as the hook: show how ARTCOVR could translate Hyperdub's archival, experimental visual language into a reusable system for reissues, new records, and licensing moments.

targets.current_signal: The official 2026 news page shows Tyondai Braxton joining the collective, a Loraine James remix, and a Hatis Noit residency tied to new material.
targets.opening_angle: Reference the Tyondai Braxton announcement and Hatis Noit's Sound Gallery residency: offer modular artwork and announcement assets that preserve Erased Tapes' avant-garde tone across releases and live moments.

targets.current_signal: The official shop shows a dense 2026 pipeline: Baauer's July single, Jacques Greene's July release, and a Cyst / Iglooghost / daisy* release dated 2026-09-04.
targets.opening_angle: Lead with the same-day 2026 release pipeline and LuckyMe's label-plus-design-studio model: ARTCOVR can help the team scale distinctive release worlds across music, merch, and digital without losing the label's design edge.

targets.current_signal: The label's 2026 news feed lists Baby Rose's Yearnalism, Jordan Patterson's EP, Eaves Wilder's debut, Wesley Joseph's album, and Yoko Ono's Season of Glass reissue.
targets.opening_angle: Open with the contrast between Baby Rose's Yearnalism campaign and the Yoko Ono reissue: offer a system that can flex across new-artist launches, catalog moments, and format-specific artwork.

targets.current_signal: TaP's current management page lists an active multi-artist roster including Dermot Kennedy, Duffy, Lana Del Rey, London Grammar, Loreen, Leigh-Anne, and Morgan Evans.
targets.decision_maker_role: Co-President & Head of Global Artist Management
targets.opening_angle: Frame ARTCOVR as a roster-wide option for management: a fast way to explore campaign artwork and platform assets for the next release while keeping each artist's visual language distinct.

targets.current_signal: Current work and services pages show ongoing artist, estate, and label projects, including integrated digital and brand work for Nick Cave and music catalog campaigns.
targets.opening_angle: Reference the Nick Cave digital/store work: ARTCOVR can plug into the studio's strategy-to-delivery process with rapid visual explorations for release identities, artwork, and campaign microsites.

targets.current_signal: The official site still leads with moisturizer as the new album and the 2026 store carries deluxe formats and live/merch assets.
targets.opening_angle: Use the moisturizer world as the opening: offer a small set of playful, tactile cover and merch directions for the deluxe/live tail of the campaign, not a generic redesign.

targets.current_signal: The official site currently promotes Expert In A Dying Field (Deluxe), video, merch, and tour activity, with Look Out Kid listed as management.
targets.decision_maker_role: Artist Manager at Look Out Kid
targets.opening_angle: Tie the pitch to the deluxe catalog and ongoing tour ecosystem: ARTCOVR can help extend The Beths' smart, high-energy visual language into alternate formats and social assets without overproducing.

targets.current_signal: The official store lists the newly released Big Dog / Knocking at the Sky tracks, From the Pyre products, and a 2026 live calendar.
targets.decision_maker_role: Digital Marketing Manager & Day-to-Day Manager at Q Prime
targets.opening_angle: Reference the Big Dog / Knocking at the Sky and From the Pyre formats: ARTCOVR can create a coherent visual kit for limited physical editions, live announcements, and digital rollout moments.

targets.current_signal: The official site still lists Bleeds out now, current tour dates, and named management, publicity, and booking routes.
targets.opening_angle: Use Bleeds plus the live cycle as the hook: offer an efficient batch of tour, merch, and social variants that keeps Wednesday's handmade visual energy intact between release moments.

targets.current_signal: Growthr's current music page showcases full creative for a Miracle release, including music video, album artwork, brand, concept, shoot, post, and delivery.
targets.opening_angle: Lead with Growthr's end-to-end Miracle case study: ARTCOVR can be a rapid visual prototyping layer for album-art directions and campaign testing before the team commits to shoot and post.
